note: Aalst: wall of c. 1200 on both banks of the Dender, given bastions in the late 16th and 17th c.; still standing in 1650 and razed after Turenne took the town in 1667. Traced from the tree-lined rampart line (Wallenring) on the Ferraris map (1777). Gate names not verified.
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Aalst' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140017)

gateSources.Brusselse Poort: inventory 140017 (Dender crossing at the later Brusselse poort)
gateSources.Gentse Poort: direction of the road to Gent on Ferraris; name uncertain
